title: Claims Business Analyst
descriptionText: We exist for workers and their employers -- who are the backbone of our economy. That is where Centivo comes in -- our mission is to bring affordable, high-quality healthcare to the millions who struggle to pay their healthcare bills. Summary of role: As a Claims Business Analyst, you will be responsible for triaging operational issues and leading projects and tasks to completion. You will use your claims adjudication experience and TPA background to triage operational concerns, vendor issues, and related claims issues. Familiarity with Centivo’s claims systems (Javelina and HealthRules Payer) is preferred. You will coordinate with all business units and external vendors during client implementations and conversions to determine requirements. This role ensures seamless integration between internal and vendor systems to support client requirements and operational workflows. Additionally, you will lead key projects and tasks identified to improve efficiency of Centivo’s Claim team. This role will use data analytics and other tools to identify areas of improvement needed in the business, scope out the initiative, and then lead the project through to completion. Responsibilities Include: - Support the Centivo Claims Team with troubleshooting issues, identifying the root cause and magnitude, and then researching and recommending the best solution. - Effectively work with end-users and operational partners to identify business needs and to ensure implementations meet business requirements and appropriately address prioritized needs. - Develop and maintain advanced reporting, dashboards, KPI’s and business insights to support operational decision-making through measurement of performance and effectiveness of processes. - Assist with creating Process Flows on new initiatives and existing processes as needed. - Function as a liaison between business and technical resources to ensure people, processes, and solutions meet or exceed the needs of our Clients and Operational areas. - Pull and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports to support Claims Operations, monitor team performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to leadership. - Work with business partners to identify and articulate business requirements in each area. Facilitate brainstorming sessions to review solution options that will solve business needs. - Assist and participate in the claims testing process for new technology, vendor, and processes. - Proactively keep abreast of vendor enhancements as well as how they integrate with existing solutions. - Collaborate with the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all aspects of the functionality of the Claims systems and act as the primary liaison with the vendor for reported issues and enhancement requests. - Work with the team on oversight of the implementation of claims platform upgrades and supporting technologies. This includes coordinating user acceptance testing with the operational leads. - Proactively identify opportunities and recommend system solutions that increase automation, resolve system deficiencies, and enhance claims processing and reporting to meet and exceed business requirements. - Participate in the assessment of new technologies, new vendors, and any system enhancements being contemplated. - Participate in internal and external meetings for plan design, strategy, and setup. - Query data or create reporting to support analysis of issues, trends or specific reporting needs for clients or providers related to claim performance. - Performs other duties as deemed essential and necessary. Required Skills and Abilities: - Advanced problem-solving skills, with a track record of researching and resolving operational issues accurately and on time. - Highly organized and able to work independently, using sound judgment to manage priorities and make decisions. - Adapts to changes in the work environment; manages competing demands and deals effectively with frequent changes, delays, or unexpected events, including production schedule pressure. - Builds strong working relationships and influences outcomes across cross-functional teams. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other web-based software applications. - Skilled in running queries and analyzing data to identify trends and issues. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills — able to explain complex or technical information clearly, and to understand and interpret complex information from others, including reimbursement policy standards. Education and Experience: - Candidates must have at least 5 years of experience within healthcare claims - Candidates must have 3 years of experience working as a Business Analyst - Candidates must have prior experience with highly automated and integrated claim adjudication systems - Understanding of health insurance benefits administration in a self-funded environment Preferred Qualifications: - Experience working with El Dorado-Javelina or HealthRules Payer - Experience working at TPA - Experience with self-funded plans - Proficient in SQL, Tableau and JIRA - Intermediate to advanced proficiency in MS Excel Work Location: - Preference for Buffalo Office - Open to Remote Centivo Values: ● Resilient – This is wicked hard. There is no easy button for healthcare affordability. Luckily, the mission makes it worth it and sustains us when things are tough. Being resilient ensures we don’t give up. ● Uncommon - The status quo stinks so we had to go out and build something better. We know the healthcare system. It isn't working for members, employers, and providers. So we're building it from scratch, from the ground up. Our focus is on making things better for them while also improving clinical results - which is bold and uncommon. ● Positive – We care about each other. It takes energy to do hard stuff, build something better and to be resilient and unconventional while doing it. Because of that, we make sure we give kudos freely and feedback with care. When our tank gets low, a team member is there to be a source of new energy. We celebrate together. We are supportive, generous, humble, and positive. Who we are: Centivo is an innovative health plan for self-funded employers on a mission to bring affordable, high-quality healthcare to the millions who struggle to pay their healthcare bills. Anchored around a primary care based ACO model, Centivo saves employers 15 to 30 percent compared to traditional insurance carriers. Employees also realize significant savings through our free primary care (including virtual), predictable copay and no-deductible benefit plan design. Centivo works with employers ranging in size from 51 employees to Fortune 500 companies. For more information, visit centivo.com http://centivo.com. Headquartered in Buffalo, NY with offices in New York City and Buffalo, Centivo is backed by leading healthcare and technology investors, including a recent round of investment from Morgan Health, a business unit of JPMorgan Chase & Co.

descriptionText: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a hands-on, startup-minded Quality Manager to help build and scale the Quality function for a peptide-focused API manufacturing site with early-phase drug product development capabilities. This role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining a practical, inspection-ready quality system that supports peptide API manufacturing, laboratory controls, and a small GMP-compliant development space for formulation and sterile finished product work intended for transfer into 503A and 503B operations. title: Senior Planner
descriptionText: Grow Therapy is on a mission to serve as the trusted partner for therapists growing their practice, and patients accessing high-quality care. Powered by technology, we are a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Following the mass increase in depression and anxiety, the need for accessibility is more important than ever. To make our vision for mental healthcare a reality, we’re building a team of entrepreneurs and mission-driven go-getters. Since launching in February 2021, we’ve empowered more than ten thousand therapists and hundreds of thousands of clients across the country and insurance landscape. We’ve raised more than $328Mm in funding, including our Series D, at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others. We’re looking for a Senior Planner to join the Brand Planning team and lead marketing strategy and execution for an emerging side of our growing business: Enterprise, Payor, and Partnerships. In this role, you’ll lead development of a marketing strategy for B2B audiences in close partnership with cross-functional leaders, including positioning and messaging, audience insights, channel planning, roadmaps and creative executions. You’ll be the owner of insights and marketing initiatives related to these audiences, and act as the connective tissue between relevant product, creative, research, data, and other teams to ensure consistency and alignment to the overall company and brand strategy. The ideal candidate is an experienced brand strategist or integrated marketer with a sharp POV, excellent ability to build trust across an organization, and translate ambiguity into actionable and clear plans. Agency and client side experience is a plus, deep B2B knowledge and experience is essential. What You’ll Be Doing - Architecting the B2B marketing approach, including understanding landscape, audiences, and most effective marketing channels and methods - Develop B2B-specific positioning and messaging architectures, elevating unique insights into the enterprise, payor, and partnership industries - Build and own integrated campaign roadmaps, defining objectives and executional plans to bring campaigns to life effectively - Serve as the liaison and connective tissue between the B2B business owners and the brand & marketing team, ensuring effective partner support plus brand alignment - Partner cross-functionally with creative, product, product marketing, lifecycle, research, data, and other relevant stakeholders to drive alignment and clarity - Develop insights and write creative briefs that translate complex business needs into inspiring direction for creative teams - Facilitate campaign kickoffs, strategic working sessions, and creative reviews, ensuring all stakeholders are anchored to B2B strategy and campaign objectives - Ensure all creative output ladders up to the broader brand strategy while addressing the distinct needs and expectations of B2B audiences - Implement scalable planning and communication rhythms that keep cross-functional partners aligned and work moving efficiently - Evaluate campaign performance in partnership with analytics, using data to continuously refine messaging strategy and improve business impact You'll Be a Good Fit If You Have - 8+ years of experience in brand strategy, brand planning, or integrated marketing—with meaningful B2B experience, ideally spanning both agency and in-house environments - Strong familiarity with B2B marketing dynamics, including longer sales cycles, hard to reach audiences, and specific seasonality dynamics - A proven track record of developing positioning and messaging for B2B audiences, multisided marketplace and/or health care experience a plus - Demonstrated expertise in writing creative briefs, developing messaging frameworks, and translating complex business needs into clear strategic narratives - Experience working cross-functionally in fast-moving organizations, with the instincts to build trust and drive alignment without direct authority - A strategic yet hands-on approach—equally comfortable developing the vision and rolling up your sleeves to make it real - Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and bring clarity to complex or emerging business areas - A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a genuine passion for building brands with consistency and purpose Employment Type: Full Time, Exempt Base Compensation: The base compensation range for this position is: Hybrid Commitment: $161,000 - $197,000 USD Annually This role is hybrid (onsite from our NYC hub location three days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). title: Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms - Yahoo Mail
descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. About the Role We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms for Yahoo Mail, to lead the product strategy and execution for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared technology integrations. This role owns the horizontal capabilities that power Yahoo Mail experiences across all platforms, including authentication, identity, privacy, security, and foundational client frameworks. This is a senior, highly cross-functional role that works deeply with application engineering teams, experience-focused product managers, and central platform and infrastructure teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that Yahoo Mail clients remain secure, compliant, scalable, and adaptable as the product ecosystem evolves. A critical dimension of this role is guiding Yahoo Mail through large-scale platform transitions and service realignments, ensuring continuity for users and partners while enabling independent execution across multiple organizations. This work requires strong systems thinking, excellent stakeholder management, and comfort operating in complex commercial and technical environments. What You’ll Do Own the product vision and roadmap for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared services across web, iOS, Android, and emerging surfaces. Define and shape the strategic roadmaps for Yahoo Mail client platforms, including decisions around codebases, architectural patterns, and technology investments that enable long-term scalability and maintainability. Partner closely with application engineering teams to ensure client platforms are built and operated in a cost-efficient manner, balancing performance, developer velocity, and operational complexity. Drive adoption of modern technologies and platform capabilities to deliver fast, reliable, and secure user experiences across all clients. Partner with AI and platform teams to enable client-side support for AI-powered experiences, ensuring Yahoo Mail clients can securely and efficiently integrate capabilities such as intelligent assistance, personalization, and emerging AI-driven features. Lead cross-platform initiatives spanning authentication, identity, privacy, security, and compliance, in close collaboration with central platform teams. Act as the connective tissue between client engineering, experience-focused product managers, and backend platform teams, ensuring cohesive end-to-end execution. Drive platform consistency while enabling differentiated experiences across clients where appropriate. Lead complex platform transitions, service separations, and long-running partner support programs that require coordination across multiple teams, organizations, and external stakeholders. Ensure client platforms are resilient to organizational change, capable of operating independently where required, and aligned with long-term commercial, legal, and regulatory constraints. Represent Yahoo Mail in executive-level discussions related to platform strategy, technical risk, timelines, and tradeoffs. Define and track success metrics across performance, security posture, reliability, cost efficiency, and developer productivity, using data to guide prioritization and investment decisions. What We’re Looking For Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of platforms, infrastructure-adjacent products, or large-scale client systems. Experience building and operating consumer applications at scale is strongly preferred. Direct experience with email platforms or messaging systems is a strong plus, given the unique technical, operational, and trust challenges of email. Application Platform Leadership: Proven ability to define and evolve shared capabilities used by many teams, balancing consistency with flexibility while keeping end users and business customers connected through reliable, scalable platforms. Technical Depth: Strong technical fluency across client architectures, authentication and identity systems, privacy and security controls, and platform integrations. Familiarity with the complexity and constraints of email ecosystems (deliverability, trust, abuse prevention, identity, and standards) is highly valued. Complex Program Ownership: Demonstrated success leading ambiguous, multi-year initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, external dependencies, and contractual considerations, while maintaining operational stability and user trust. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to align engineering, legal, privacy, security, commercial, and executive stakeholders around a common plan, particularly in environments where platforms serve both consumers and enterprise partners. Product Judgment: Strong instincts for risk management, sequencing, and tradeoffs in high-impact, high-visibility environments, with a focus on protecting user trust and long-term platform health. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical, organizational, and platform concepts to senior audiences. Mission & Product Mindset: A genuine interest in building products that empower people in their day-to-day lives, with an appreciation for email as a vital, enduring communications tool that continues to have real-world impact at a global scale Your Day-to-Day Partner with client and platform engineering leaders to translate strategic goals into executable roadmaps. Collaborate with experienced product managers to ensure platform capabilities enable high-quality user experiences across all clients. Work closely with identity, authentication, privacy, and security teams to ensure compliant and secure implementations. Lead planning and execution for major platform changes, transitions, and long-term initiatives. Identify risks early, drive alignment on mitigation strategies, and keep senior leadership informed. Serve as a trusted product leader for some of the most complex and foundational work within Yahoo Mail. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

This role is responsible for ensuring products meet applicable international safety, regulatory, and certification requirements throughout the product development lifecycle. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with Research & Development, Quality, external certification agencies, suppliers, and customers to facilitate timely project execution and successful market access. This position requires strong technical judgment, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Partner with R&D and cross-functional stakeholders to review and prepare certification-related documentation and technical submissions. Coordinate with external certification bodies, suppliers, and customers to support project execution and ensure deliverables are completed within established timelines. title: Principal Engineer
descriptionText: Principal Engineer, Systems Modeling Architect Position Summary Stanley Black & Decker is seeking a Principal Engineer, Systems Modeling Architect to lead the development of advanced plant models, simulation frameworks, and engineering applications supporting next-generation electromechanical product development. This role is centered on plant modeling, multi-domain and multi-scale modeling, and model-based design & development, with reduced emphasis on traditional systems engineering ownership and detailed compliance/code interpretation. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in physics-based modeling of complex systems, including the ability to translate abstract physical methods, mathematical formulations, and engineering concepts into robust, executable models and custom-developed simulation components. The engineer will develop and deploy models across electrical, mechanical, thermal, fluid, and controls-interactive domains, using tools such as Dymola, TwinBuilder, Amesim, Modelica-based platforms, and Simulink/Simscape. This role also includes responsibility for custom model development, application/code development, model interfacing, compilation, and runtime execution, requiring strong technical depth in physics, mathematics, and electrical engineering. This individual will work closely with CAE engineers, other MBD engineers, embedded software engineers, and systems engineering teams to ensure models are technically accurate, scalable, and usable across analysis, controls, and product development workflows. Key Responsibilities Lead development of high-fidelity plant models for complex electromechanical systems using Dymola, TwinBuilder, Amesim, Modelica, Simulink, and Simscape or equivalent tools. Develop multi-scale and multi-domain models spanning component, subsystem, and system-level behavior across electrical, mechanical, thermal, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-coupled domains. Translate abstract methods, first-principles equations, reduced-order formulations, and engineering concepts into practical, validated, and reusable simulation models. Perform custom model and library development to represent unique physics, behaviors, interfaces, and product architectures not available in standard toolsets. Build supporting engineering applications, scripts, utilities, and automation workflows to improve model usability, execution speed, and integration into development processes. Support code generation, model compilation, solver configuration, co-simulation setup, FMU export/import, and runtime integration across development environments. Create interfaces between plant models and external applications, controllers, embedded software components, and test platforms. Partner with CAE engineers to align system-level and reduced-order models with detailed simulation results, test data, and product physics. Collaborate with MBD and controls engineers to provide plant models suitable for MIL, SIL, HIL, and closed-loop controls development. Work with embedded software engineers to support executable deployment, runtime validation, and integration of models into software and test ecosystems. Perform model verification, validation, calibration, sensitivity analysis, and performance optimization using simulation and test data. Contribute to simulation architecture decisions related to model reuse, interoperability, deployment strategy, abstraction level, and framework scalability. Document model assumptions, governing equations, parameter sources, interfaces, limitations, and validation results. Provide technical leadership and mentoring in plant modeling, multi-scale simulation methods, and custom model/application development. Required Qualifications Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Controls Engineering, Applied Physics, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. 5+ years of relevant experience in plant modeling, model-based design, physical system simulation, or engineering application development. Strong hands-on experience with one or more plant modeling environments such as Dymola, TwinBuilder, Amesim, Modelica-based tools, Simulink, or Simscape. Demonstrated expertise in plant modeling, multi-scale modeling, and multi-domain physics-based simulation. Proven ability to translate abstract methods, mathematical formulations, and first-principles physics into executable and validated engineering models. Experience with custom model development, user-defined components, libraries, or frameworks for simulation environments. Strong foundation in physics, mathematics, numerical methods, and dynamic systems. Strong technical background in electrical systems and their interaction with mechanical and control domains in electromechanical products. Experience with application development, scripting, or software/tool development to support simulation workflows and automation. Experience interfacing models with external software or simulation environments, including compilation, runtime execution, co-simulation, or executable deployment. Ability to collaborate effectively across CAE, MBD, embedded software, controls, hardware, and systems engineering teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain model assumptions, limitations, and results clearly. Preferred Qualifications Ph.D. preferred for candidates with deep expertise in multi-scale modeling, advanced physical system simulation, or custom model framework development. Experience with Modelica-based development and object-oriented physical system modeling practices. Experience with FMU/FMI workflows, co-simulation frameworks, solver tuning, and model exchange across tools. Experience with compiled runtime models, simulation executables, or deployment of engineering models into internal engineering applications. Experience with Python, MATLAB, C, or C++ for workflow automation, model integration, or engineering software development. Experience supporting MIL, SIL, and HIL environments. Experience in industrial equipment, power tools, outdoor power equipment, robotics, automation, automotive, aerospace, or other hardware-intensive electromechanical systems. Experience modeling motors, inverters, actuators, drivetrains, batteries, thermal systems, fluid systems, or power electronics. Experience with parameter estimation, model reduction, and validation against laboratory or field data. Familiarity with embedded software interfaces, controller integration, and real-time or near-real-time simulation constraints. Experience with version control, engineering data management, and model governance practices. Tools & Technologies Plant Modeling / Simulation: Dymola, TwinBuilder, Amesim, Modelica, MATLAB, Simulink, Simscape Programming / Application Development: Python, MATLAB, C, C++, scripting and automation tools Integration / Runtime: FMI/FMU, co-simulation frameworks, compiled model execution, solver configuration Validation / Test: MIL, SIL, HIL, calibration workflows, correlation, test data analysis Collaboration / Lifecycle: Version control, PLM/ALM, engineering data management tools Soft Skills Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with CAE, MBD, embedded software, hardware, and systems engineering teams. Ability to translate complex physical behavior and abstract engineering methods into practical, maintainable, and validated models. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. Sound engineering judgment in selecting the appropriate model fidelity and abstraction level for the intended use case. Ability to balance technical rigor with execution speed and usability. Strong documentation discipline and attention to detail. Technical leadership through influence, mentoring, and clear communication. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced product development environment. We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company. Global Benefits & Perks You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire. What You’ll Also Get Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. Learning & Development: Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities). Diverse & Inclusive Culture: We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too. Purpose-Driven Company: You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

title: Associate Data Engineer (Georgia Tech Only)
descriptionText: Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam. We’re hiring Data Engineers graduating between December 2026 and June 2027 to join our data team in Miami, starting May or June 2027. This is not a rotational program and it isn’t a shadowing role. You’ll work on the pipelines and integrations that make OneImaging’s data the source of truth for the business - from the raw feed coming out of a payer, a provider, or our own platform, through the transformation logic, to the dashboard or automation that someone in operations, finance, or care navigation actually relies on every day. It also means you’ll be building alongside a team that has moved unusually early on AI-assisted engineering. We run a shared AI harness that every engineer’s agent builds on, and we’re explicit internally that writing code is no longer the slow part of the job - the slow parts are deciding what to build and verifying what comes out. We’ll expect you to use these tools heavily and to own everything they produce for you. What you'll do: Build and maintain data pipelines in Databricks (SparkSQL/PySpark) that ingest, transform, and validate data from sources like our platform databases, payer eligibility files, provider and claims systems, and third-party APIs - with a senior engineer as your mentor and reviewer Work across the full path a dataset takes - ingestion, transformation, modeling, and the Looker dashboard or downstream workflow it feeds - with guidance at first and increasing independence as you go Help build and maintain automated inbound/outbound file exchanges (eligibility, claims status, reporting) that other teams depend on to run their day-to-day operations Work with AI coding agents as a normal part of your workflow, and take full accountability for the output: you should be able to explain every file in your diff Write tests and validation checks for your pipelines, and treat data quality as part of shipping rather than a phase afterwards Participate in design reviews and code reviews from your first weeks - including reviewing other engineers’ work, because a bare approval with no comment isn’t a completed review here Ask why. We reason from first principles and we have an explicit norm that engineers are not implementation machines - if a requirement doesn’t make sense, we want you to say so Handle protected health information correctly, with data governance, access controls, and audit logging as first-class requirements rather than afterthoughts About you: Graduating with a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline between December 2026 and June 2027 You’ve built things nobody assigned you - side projects, coursework you took further than required, hackathon work, something with real data, however small Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python for data processing Some exposure to Databricks, Spark, or a similar distributed data processing tool - coursework, an internship, or a personal project is enough; we don’t expect production experience A basic mental model of how data moves from a source system into a warehouse or lakehouse and out to a report You use AI coding tools and you’ve formed opinions about them - including where they mislead you and how you catch it You can explain a technical decision you made and what you’d do differently, which matters more to us than the sophistication of the project Comfortable with ambiguity and with being told “we haven’t figured that out yet” Intellectually honest: you can change your mind when the evidence changes, and you’d rather delete your own work than defend it Clear written and verbal communication - you’ll be writing documentation and PR descriptions that other teams depend on Authorized to work in the United States, and able to be based in Miami Nice to have, and genuinely not required: An internship or co-op where you shipped a data pipeline or report to production Experience with a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) or building a dashboard someone other than you used Exposure to AWS or another cloud provider Familiarity with relational or document databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) Anything you’ve built on top of LLM or agent APIs - tools, harnesses, evals, agents Curiosity about healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, DICOM) or claims/eligibility data - we’ll teach you these, and we’d rather you question how things are done in healthcare than arrive already knowing Coursework or projects involving statistics, data modeling, or data warehousing concepts What we'll give you A published career framework with written promotion criteria, so you can see the path from Associate Software Engineer through Senior, Staff and Principal, and know exactly what's expected at each step. A mentor from among our senior engineers, for whom mentorship is a written part of their job. Real ownership, quickly. And a mission that's easy to get behind with real life impact. The base salary range for this position is $85,000 - $115,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans. Fraud and Security Notice: Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our team uses the oneimaging.com email domain exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a OneImaging recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to candidateprotection@oneimaging.com. Equal Employment Opportunity: OneImaging is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. OneImaging is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@oneimaging.com.

Our engineering team is around twenty people, which means the work you ship is visibly yours and the distance between your code and a patient getting a scan scheduled is very short. It also means you'll be building alongside a team that has moved unusually early on AI-assisted engineering. We run a shared AI harness that every engineer's agent builds on, we have AI agents running in production behind guardrails and eval suites, and we're explicit internally that writing code is no longer the slow part of the job — the slow parts are deciding what to build and verifying what comes out. We'll expect you to use these tools heavily and to own everything they produce for you. What you'll do: Build and ship full stack features across our React frontend and TypeScript/Node.js backend, with a senior engineer as your mentor and reviewer Work across every layer of a feature — the migration, the API, the interface, the tests — with guidance at first and increasing independence as you go. We reason from first principles and we have an explicit norm that engineers are not implementation machines — if a requirement doesn't make sense, we want you to say so Build features that handle protected health information correctly, with authentication, authorization, and audit logging as first-class requirements rather than afterthoughts About you: Graduating with a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline between December 2026 and June 2027 You've built things nobody assigned you — side projects, hackathon work, open-source contributions, something with real users, however few Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and comfort with either React or Node.js. We care much more about how you reason than about which technologies you've already used Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, and a basic mental model of how a web request becomes a database query You use AI coding tools and you've formed opinions about them — including where they mislead you and how you catch it You can explain a technical decision you made and what you'd do differently, which matters more to us than the sophistication of the project Comfortable with ambiguity and with being told "we haven't figured that out yet" Intellectually honest: you can change your mind when the evidence changes, and you'd rather delete your own work than defend it Clear written and verbal communication — you'll be writing design docs and PR descriptions that other people depend on Authorized to work in the United States, and able to be based in Miami Nice to have, and genuinely not required: An internship or co-op where you shipped to production Experience with PostgreSQL, Express, or a typed API layer Anything you've built on top of LLM or agent APIs — tools, harnesses, evals, agents Testing experience with Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or similar Exposure to AWS or another cloud provider Curiosity about healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7, DICOM) — we'll teach you these, and we'd rather you question how things are done in radiology than arrive already knowing A background in accessibility or internationalization What we'll give you A published career framework with written promotion criteria, so you can see the path from Associate Software Engineer through Senior, Staff and Principal, and know exactly what's expected at each step. title: Sourcing Specialist
descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. The Sourcing Specialist is an experienced, detail-oriented professional responsible for resolving Xometry’s most challenging manufacturing projects. This role focuses on manually coordinating and placing orders that fall outside of our standard automated sourcing workflows. Sourcing Specialists manage complex or escalated manufacturing projects. This involves in-depth technical review, strategic problem-solving, and creative outreach to ensure successful placement with qualified manufacturing partners. This position requires a combination of sourcing expertise, critical thinking, and strong cross-functional collaboration. Specialists work closely with suppliers, customers, engineers, and internal teams to identify solutions for unique or high-priority orders. Projects involve a variety of manufacturing processes, including CNC machining, sheet-metal fabrication, and additive printing. Success hinges on both technical understanding and sound judgment to achieve cost, quality, and delivery goals. How You’ll Contribute: Manage a portfolio of advanced sourcing cases for orders that require detailed technical or pricing analysis and extended follow-up to get them placed with a production team. Investigate root causes preventing supplier acceptance and develop targeted recovery strategies for stalled projects. Review technical documentation and manufacturing drawings with our engineers, clients, or manufacturers, to validate feasibility and identify potential risks or clarifications needed. Collaborate cross-functionally with design engineers, manual quoters, case managers, and sales to resolve technical or scheduling concerns. Communicate directly with both suppliers and customers to clarify requirements, negotiate terms, and align expectations. Maintain comprehensive case notes and documentation to ensure leadership visibility and continuity across active escalations. Provide informal guidance and technical support to Sourcing Coordinators, serving as a resource for more complex or unfamiliar situations. What You’ll Bring to Xometry: Analytical and technically minded, with working knowledge of manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, sheet-metal fabrication, or additive manufacturing. Strong sourcing, procurement, or supplier-management background, ideally in a manufacturing or engineering-related environment. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and basic GD&T. Competence with online research and cost-validation for raw materials, finishing services, etc. Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills for coordinating between multiple stakeholders. Organized and self-driven, with the ability to prioritize and resolve longer-term or multi-stage sourcing cases. Proficiency with Google Sheets and Docs (Salesforce experience a plus). Qualifications: 3 + years of experience in sourcing, procurement, or supply-chain management, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Demonstrated success resolving complex supplier or production challenges. Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality results under time constraints. Comfortable making independent decisions within defined pricing and policy parameters. Strong curiosity for manufacturing and desire to expand technical knowledge The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $68,000- $75,000 annually depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. title: Principle Engineer
descriptionText: 岗位定位 面向电动工具及相关机电系统的下一代技术发展需求，负责先进控制理论、系统建模方法、CAE AI应用及模型驱动开发体系的研究与落地。该岗位将聚焦复杂机电系统的控制与建模前沿方向，探索可转化为产品竞争力和研发效率提升的关键技术，并推动相关研究成果在平台开发、新产品预研和软件开发流程中的工程化应用。 本岗位适合具有扎实控制理论基础、较强科研创新能力和工程转化意识的高层次博士人才。 核心职责 1. 前沿控制与系统建模研究 面向电动工具及相关复杂机电系统，开展先进控制理论、系统建模方法和智能化研发技术研究。 研究鲁棒控制、自适应控制、优化控制、智能控制、数据驱动建模等方向在实际产品中的应用潜力。 跟踪国内外前沿技术发展趋势，识别对未来产品平台和研发体系具有战略价值的关键技术方向。 2. CAE AI与智能工程方法探索 探索CAE与AI融合技术在产品设计、性能预测、参数优化、故障分析和研发提效中的应用。 推动仿真驱动、数据驱动和模型驱动方法在电动工具研发中的结合应用。 研究面向复杂系统的智能建模、代理模型、参数识别、虚拟验证等新方法。 3. 基于System Modeling的软件开发方法建设 推动基于System Modeling / Model-Based Development的软件开发方法在控制系统开发中的应用。 建立从系统需求、功能建模、控制设计、仿真验证到软件实现的开发流程与方法框架。 支持控制策略、系统架构和软件实现之间的一致性设计与验证。 4. 研究成果工程化转化 将前沿研究成果转化为可复用的研发方法、分析工具、建模规范、设计标准和技术平台能力。 支持研发团队将先进控制与建模方法应用于新产品开发、平台开发和关键技术攻关。 与机械、电子、电机、软件、测试等团队协同，推动研究成果在工程场景中的落地与验证。 5. 技术影响力与创新体系建设 参与或主导高水平技术课题、联合研究项目和外部技术合作。 推动专利、论文、技术白皮书、内部方法论和标准体系建设。 为团队提供系统控制、建模仿真和智能研发方向的技术指导，提升组织在前沿技术领域的能力积累。 任职资格 教育背景 博士学历，控制科学与工程、电气工程、自动化、系统工程、机电控制、机械电子工程或相关专业。 优先考虑国内外Top高校或知名研究团队背景。 研究与工作经验 具备先进控制、系统建模、模型驱动开发、智能控制、CAE相关方向的深入研究基础。 有复杂机电系统、电驱系统、机器人、汽车电控、工业装备、航空航天控制或相关领域研究/开发经验者优先。 具备将理论研究转化为工程方法、工具链或产品能力的经验者优先。 有高水平论文、核心专利、重大科研项目或产学研合作经历者优先。 专业能力 具备扎实的控制理论基础，对系统动力学、建模、控制与优化有深入理解。 熟悉一种或多种先进控制方法，如鲁棒控制、自适应控制、最优控制、预测控制、智能控制等。 熟悉系统建模、仿真分析和模型驱动开发方法，能够建立复杂系统的分析与设计框架。 了解CAE工具链、数据驱动方法、AI在工程研发中的应用逻辑。 具备较强的软件思维，理解控制算法到软件实现的转化过程。 具备优秀的科研能力、问题抽象能力、技术判断能力和跨团队协同能力。 优先条件 有MATLAB/Simulink、Modelica、AMESim、Ansys Twin Builder、Python或相关建模/仿真/算法工具使用经验。 有数字孪生、虚拟验证、代理模型、参数辨识、智能优化等方向经验者优先。 有电动工具、园林工具、手持设备或高动态机电产品相关经验者优先。 有技术路线规划、平台方法建设或研究团队带领经验者优先。 关键产出方向 前沿控制与系统建模方向的技术突破与方法沉淀 CAE AI与模型驱动开发在研发流程中的应用落地 支撑新产品平台开发的建模、分析与控制方法体系 高价值专利、论文、技术标准及内部研发资产 组织在先进控制与智能工程方向的能力提升 We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. title: Authorization Supervisor
descriptionText: Grow Therapy is on a mission to serve as the trusted partner for therapists growing their practice, and patients accessing high-quality care. Powered by technology, we are a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Following the mass increase in depression and anxiety, the need for accessibility is more important than ever. To make our vision for mental healthcare a reality, we’re building a team of entrepreneurs and mission-driven go-getters. Since launching in February 2021, we’ve empowered more than ten thousand therapists and hundreds of thousands of clients across the country and insurance landscape. We’ve raised more than $328Mm in funding, including our Series D, at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others. We are looking for an experienced Authorization Supervisor to build and own our authorization function. This is a workstream that has outgrown its original home inside Eligibility and is now one of the most complex, highest-risk parts of our Pre-Bill operation, covering our WellHive partnership with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP) partners (Cigna, Octave, Optum), and Kaiser populations. You'll own the authorization-denial pipeline at the trend level, manage the Authorization Specialist and our outsourced authorization-entry team, and serve as the primary relationship owner for authorization-specific issues with key payer and partner contacts. You'll report directly to the Pre-Bill Operations Manager and work closely with the Eligibility, Billing, and Coding supervisors. This function increasingly runs on data and workflow tooling rather than manual queue work, so this role is as much about building and maintaining automated processes as it is about managing a team. What You'll Be Doing: The Authorization function is one of the most complex and highest-risk parts of Grow's Pre-Bill operation. As Authorization Supervisor, you'll own it end-to-end: the denial pipeline, the team that processes authorizations, and the partner relationships that keep it running. This role leans more toward building than managing an existing queue, so you'll spend real time standing up workflows and automation, not just overseeing one. In this role, you will... - Own the authorization denial pipeline at the trend level, identifying root causes across payers and driving resolution rather than fixing claims one at a time - Build and maintain automated workflows that reduce manual authorization work over time - Manage and develop an authorization team, including staffing, quality audits, and productivity standards - Own key partner relationships for authorization-specific issues, including escalations and process improvements - Represent the authorization function in cross-functional conversations with payor partnerships on escalation and process improvement - Partner with Billing, Eligibility, and Coding to resolve cross-functional authorization issues and escalate systemic trends - Prepare the function for new frameworks and partnerships as Grow expands You'll Be a Good Fit If: - You have 3+ years of experience in authorization, utilization management, patient access, or medical billing, including at least 1 year in a people management role - You're SQL-fluent or can ramp up quickly, and you're comfortable directing and verifying data-driven, automated workflows, even if you're not writing every query yourself - You have prior people management experience, ideally in authorization, utilization management, or patient access - You're analytically minded and can spot a denial trend across payers rather than treating each case in isolation - You're comfortable owning external partner relationships and escalating issues professionally - You're process-driven and can build and enforce repeatable workflows for a high-volume, high-complexity function - You're adaptable and can ramp into a fast-moving, partially built environment without a long runway Bonus points if you have: - Prior VA Community Care Network or other government payer authorization experience - Prior Employee Assistance Program experience (Cigna, Octave, or similar) - Experience building or scaling an operational function from an ad hoc or manual state - Hands-on SQL or workflow-automation experience, even self-taught Employment Type: Salaried, Exempt Base Compensation: The base compensation range for this position is: Fully Remote Commitment: $74,880-$84,240 USD Annually This role is fully remote. descriptionText: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. The Demand Planning Senior Manager drives forecast accuracy and inventory health across the assigned product portfolio. This role owns the consensus demand signal, leads monthly Demand Review pre-alignment forums, and partners closely with Commercial, Brand, Supply Planning, and Finance teams to ensure the demand plan reflects brand strategy and market realities. If you love turning complex data into clear decisions that move a business forward, this role was built for you! Effective from the date that Hasbro opens its new Boston location, this position will be onsite Tuesday – Thursday at Hasbro’s new HQ location in Boston, MA. In the interim, this position will be onsite Tuesday –Thursday at Hasbro’s HQ in Pawtucket, RI or at Hasbro’s temporary location in Boston, MA. A Day in the Life of a Sr. Manager Demand Planning You will generate and maintain an 18–24-month phased demand forecast, collaborating on baseline creation, reconciling enrichments, and publishing the final consensus forecast. You will own the monthly Demand Review (DMR) pre-alignment cycle — preparing Brand leaders, securing forecast approval, defining risks and opportunities, and documenting demand drivers and assumptions. The forecast is developed by analyzing Shipment (Sell-In), POS (Sell-Out), market share, cannibalization, and other commercial signals, all within the global forecasting calendar and planning process. You will proactively communicate demand changes to supply planning and work through service and inventory impacts. You will partner with Sales & Marketing to evaluate promotional impact on demand, using post-evaluation analysis to quantify uplift. This includes challenging or validating forward-looking overlays for new launches, promotions, price changes, seasonal spikes, and entertainment windows, with forecast enrichment quality measured via Forecast Value Add (FVA). Data quality is the foundation of everything we do. You will collaborate with statistical modelers on baseline creation and validation (including ML/LLM techniques), conduct historical data cleansing, and perform weekly integrity checks on the demand signal passed to supply chain. You will own Demand Management metrics (FVA, Forecast Mix Error, Forecast Bias), lead root cause analysis, and drive improvement with brand and sales teams — continuously refining cross-functional routines across Marketing, Sales, and Supply/Demand Planning to optimize supply chain performance and customer experience. You will work closely with planning leadership, Brand teams, Sales, Supply Planning, and Finance. Externally, you will partner with DP service partners such as Genpact. What You Bring Bachelor's Degree 5+ years of demand planning experience with a track record of influencing senior commercial leaders Deep expertise in Integrated Business Planning / S&OP frameworks Advanced skills in segmentation, statistical modeling, historical cleansing, and forecast accuracy/bias analysis Experience evaluating new product demand and collaborating on commercial strategy Proficiency in SAP APO, Logility, and Power BI; toy/fashion industry experience and APICS certification preferred A direct, confident communication style — you back your positions with data and know when to push back Proactive and adaptable; effective in matrixed organizations Accountable for metric performance and consistent in following through on data-driven recommendations Passion for building planning standards and bringing others along in adopting them! title: Director of Product
descriptionText: COME JOIN OUR PRODUCT TEAM! High velocity, high intensity, high trust, high bar, high impact, and a will to win. If those words resonate deeply with you, this could be your next career move. We're seeking someone who leads with humility, pursues audacious goals, and is motivated by meaningful impact on people and the world. At FutureFit AI, our core mission is to help more people get to better jobs faster and cheaper, with a specific focus on those facing barriers to opportunity. Our work helps resolve the growing issue of economic inequality, ensuring that no one is left behind in the future of work. Our AI-powered platform brings efficiency and insight to workforce development, replacing outdated systems and unlocking human potential at scale. Ready to make an impact? Apply today. Important note: Data shows that men typically apply when meeting 3/10 requirements, while women often wait until it's 10/10. We encourage you to apply if you see a strong (not necessarily perfect) fit. YOUR ROLE The Director of Product is the operating backbone of FutureFit AI's product team — the person who turns company-level strategy into a shipped, sequenced, resourced roadmap, and who makes sure every stakeholder — engineering, data, GTM, and our customers — knows what's coming and why. This is not a strategy-only seat: you will manage a team of builders (three Sr. TPMs and a Design Lead) while personally owning the connective tissue across their domains: the integrated roadmap, the capacity model, the metrics that tell us whether the product is working, and the cadences that keep several functions moving in the same direction. OWNERSHIP AREAS - Team Leadership: 4 direct reports — 3 Senior TPMs and 1 Design Lead - Integrated Roadmap & Capacity Plan: a single source-of-truth roadmap across all product domains, reconciled against actual engineering and data capacity. - Cross-Company Product Cadences: the bridge meetings, monthly gates, and quarterly planning sessions that keep Build, GTM, and leadership in sync. - Product Metrics, Tracking & Ops: the north-star and domain-level metrics stack, instrumentation standards, and the operating rhythm that makes metrics actionable. - Product Strategy Contribution & Documentation: the living strategy docs, OKRs, and narrative artifacts that keep the roadmap grounded in “why.” - Competitive Landscape & Analysis: ongoing competitive intelligence, with particular attention to AI-native and agentic entrants in workforce tech. - Stakeholder Management: executive, board, customer, and cross-functional relationships that sit above any single domain and need great artifacts about what’s happening now, next, and later with the solution, and why. WHAT YOU'LL DO LEAD & DEVELOP THE PRODUCT TEAM - Manage 4 direct reports (3 Sr. TPMs, 1 Design Lead) — set goals, run 1:1s, give craft feedback on PRDs, discovery, and design work, and grow each of them toward their next level. - Build the operating norms — rituals, discovery rhythms, documentation standards, craft bar — that let a small, high-context team punch above its weight. - Be the escalation point when a Sr. TPM or the Design Lead needs help unblocking a stakeholder, resolving a scope fight, or navigating a resourcing conflict. OWN THE INTEGRATED ROADMAP & CAPACITY PLAN - Maintain a single, coherent roadmap across every product domain — reconciling individual Sr. TPM roadmaps into one view that leadership and GTM can trust. - Own the capacity plan: translate roadmap commitments into engineering, data, and design capacity, flag conflicts early, and make the sequencing trade-offs when demand outstrips supply. - Partner with the VP of Engineering and VP of ML & AI to keep the roadmap grounded in what's actually buildable each sprint and quarter. - Re-forecast and re-sequence in response to new state contracts, compliance deadlines, or shifting priorities — while maintaining trust in the overall accuracy and predictability of the roadmap. DRIVE CROSS-COMPANY PRODUCT CADENCES - Run the recurring mechanisms that keep the company aligned: monthly stage gates, bridge-building syncs with GTM and CS, and quarterly planning sessions. - Own the meeting architecture for product so time in the room is spent deciding, not reporting status. - Represent product in company-wide and board-level updates, translating roadmap progress into language executives and customers care about. OWN PRODUCT METRICS, TRACKING & OPS - Own the product metrics stack end-to-end: definitions, instrumentation, dashboards, and the review cadence that makes metrics part of how decisions get made. - Roll up domain-level metrics owned by each Sr. TPM into a company-level view tied to FutureFit's north star — lifetime wages over cost to serve. - Build and maintain the product ops backbone — the tooling, templates, and processes that keep the org's PDLC running without heroics. CONTRIBUTE TO AND MAINTAIN PRODUCT STRATEGY DOCUMENTATION - Own the living strategy documents — product strategy deck, OKRs, EOS-style artifacts — keeping them current as market, customer, and company context shifts. - Translate executive-level objectives into key results that describe the work to be done in the next 2-3 quarters in a format that the broader team, board, and customers can use as a reference of record. - Facilitate quarterly OKR refinement and ensure domain-level objectives ladder up to company strategy. OWN COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE & ANALYSIS - Maintain an ongoing view of the competitive landscape in workforce tech and adjacent AI-native entrants, refreshed on a regular cadence rather than produced ad hoc for a single deal. - Translate competitive intelligence into roadmap and positioning implications that Build leadership and GTM team can act on. - Brief Sales, CS, and leadership ahead of competitive deals or RFPs. MANAGE STAKEHOLDERS - Be the day-to-day product point of contact for engineering, data, GTM, and CS leadership — the person those teams call when they need a product answer. - Manage relationships with state agency and workforce intermediary stakeholders on cross-cutting product questions that sit outside any single Sr. TPM's domain. - Keep the CPO and executive team informed with the right signal, at the right altitude, at the right time — no surprises. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR REQUIRED - Experience managing a team of PMs, TPMs, or designers directly — you know how to grow people, not just manage a roadmap. - Track record owning a company-level (not just single-domain) product roadmap and reconciling it against real engineering and data capacity. - Comfort running recurring cross-functional cadences — planning, gates, exec and board updates — as the person who owns the mechanism, not just a participant. - Strong metrics fluency — you can define a metrics stack from scratch and run a review cadence that drives decisions, not just report numbers. - Experience translating strategy into durable documentation (OKRs, strategy decks, roadmaps) that a broader org and external stakeholders rely on. - Demonstrated stakeholder management across engineering, GTM/CS, and, ideally, enterprise or government customers. - B2B SaaS, govtech, or workforce technology experience preferred; multi-stakeholder platforms — where the end user, the buyer, and the operator are different people — are a strong plus. HOW WE EVALUATE DIRECTORS OF PRODUCT AT FUTUREFIT AI Drawn from the FutureFit AI Build Team Career Rubrics, Directors of Product are expected to demonstrate: - Strategy: Owns a company-level point of view connecting the integrated roadmap to FutureFit's revenue and mission goals, with clear articulation of sequencing trade-offs across domains. - Team Leadership: Grows direct reports' craft and scope over time; is the person the team credits for their next promotion. - Execution & Ops: Runs a metrics and cadence operation — gates, reviews, planning — that the company relies on without reminders. - Cross-Functional Trust: Is the default escalation point for engineering, GTM, and CS when a product question needs an answer above the domain level. - Communication: Translates roadmap and metrics into board- and exec-ready narrative without losing technical accuracy. - Competitive & Market Judgment: Keeps the org's view of the market current and turns it into roadmap or positioning action, not just a slide.
